entities.summary: Vladimir Artyomovich Zhoga, also known by his nom de guerre Vokha, was a separatist who commanded the Sparta Battalion, a pro-Russian separatist force that is involved in the Russo-Ukrainian War. He was also the son of the Russian political military commander, Artem Zhoga.
